title.narrative: Community-Based Child Protection Mechanism for the Children of Garment Workers in Bangladesh

description.narrative: The children of RMG (Ready-Made Garment) workers are easy prey for abuse and exploitation since the parents leave them alone or in the care of older siblings and neighbours in the slums.  Many of these children are vulnerable to hazardous work, sexual exploitation, and violence.  Most of their children do not have access to education and protection services. The minimum wages earned by the RMG workers are inadequate to meet the living expenses of the family. Moreover, they do not have access to relevant government services in terms of child protection and development.
